verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is an equity-management SaaS, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask. The evidence shows only deterministic features: scenario modeling, IRR calculations, automated data-room organization, smart-linking and template-based 'generative' document workflows. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
